nodes.name: Publisher Schedule
nodes.notes: Hourly polling limits idle executions. One approved destination per run; same shared file is published separately to both accounts. Run manually after approval for faster posting.

parameters.query:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.asset_id, p.job_id, j.config, j.manifest
  FROM yt_agent.publications p
  JOIN yt_agent.jobs j ON j.id=p.job_id
  JOIN yt_agent.assets a ON a.id=p.asset_id AND a.job_id=j.id AND a.revision=j.revision
  WHERE p.status='pending' AND p.checkpoint='{}'::jsonb
    AND a.status='ready' AND j.status IN ('approved','partial')
    AND j.approved_hash=j.manifest_hash
    AND encode(digest(j.manifest::text,'sha256'),'hex')=j.approved_hash
    AND (j.manifest->>'revision')::integer=j.revision
    AND j.manifest->>'job_id'=j.id::text
    AND (j.manifest->>'publish_after' IS NULL OR (j.manifest->>'publish_after')::timestamptz<=now())
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM yt_agent.publications blocked WHERE blocked.job_id=j.id AND blocked.status IN ('uncertain','publishing'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(j.manifest->'assets') frozen WHERE frozen->>'id'=a.id::text)
  ORDER BY j.created_at,p.id
  FOR UPDATE OF p,j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE yt_agent.publications p SET status='publishing',started_at=now(),updated_at=now(),
    checkpoint='{"stage":"claimed"}'::jsonb
  FROM candidate c WHERE p.id=c.id RETURNING p.id
), mark_job AS (
  UPDATE yt_agent.jobs j SET status='publishing',updated_at=now()
  FROM candidate c,claimed p WHERE j.id=c.job_id AND p.id=c.id RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT c.id::text AS publication_id,c.job_id::text,c.asset_id::text,c.config,frozen AS asset
FROM candidate c JOIN claimed p ON p.id=c.id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.manifest->'assets') frozen
WHERE frozen->>'id'=c.asset_id::text;
UPDATE yt_agent.publications SET checkpoint=$2::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='publishing' RETURNING id::text AS publication_id,checkpoint;
UPDATE yt_agent.publications SET checkpoint=$2::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='publishing' RETURNING id::text AS publication_id,checkpoint;
UPDATE yt_agent.publications SET checkpoint=$2::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='publishing' RETURNING id::text AS publication_id,checkpoint;
UPDATE yt_agent.publications SET checkpoint=$2::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='publishing' RETURNING id::text AS publication_id,checkpoint;

WITH saved AS (
 UPDATE yt_agent.publications SET status='published',result=$2::jsonb,
 checkpoint=checkpoint||jsonb_build_object('stage','published'),updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='publishing' RETURNING id,job_id,result
), logged AS (
 INSERT INTO yt_agent.audit(job_id,event,detail) SELECT job_id,'published',result FROM saved
)
UPDATE yt_agent.jobs j SET updated_at=now(), status=CASE
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM yt_agent.publications p,saved s WHERE p.job_id=j.id AND p.id<>s.id AND p.status='uncertain') THEN 'uncertain'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM yt_agent.publications p,saved s WHERE p.job_id=j.id AND p.id<>s.id AND p.status='failed') THEN 'partial'
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM yt_agent.publications p,saved s WHERE p.job_id=j.id AND p.id<>s.id AND p.status<>'published') THEN 'approved'
 ELSE 'published' END
FROM saved s WHERE j.id=s.job_id RETURNING j.id::text AS job_id,j.status,s.result;

parameters.content:
## Configure and import inactive
Uses only native n8n nodes: PostgreSQL, Crypto, HTTP Request, Wait, Code.

1. Run workflow 00 schema setup; map YT-Agent Database, YouTube, Instagram credentials.
2. Set Publisher Config allowedMediaHosts to exact render CDN hosts and publishingEnabled=true only after setup.
3. Claim one approved artifact per tick. Immutable manifest SHA256 is checked in PostgreSQL, downloaded media SHA256/size is checked before provider calls.
4. YouTube upload URL and Instagram container/publish intent persist before publication.

No HTTP mutation retries. A lost response becomes uncertain; the job stops. Never retry a failed execution from the mutating node or edit a publication back to pending. For YouTube reconcile the saved session with an empty PUT, Content-Range: bytes */TOTAL. For Instagram inspect container status and account media. These workflows do not promise exactly-once publication.

Use durable immutable media URLs. Instagram fetches by URL after local verification; keep the same object available. No custom Python/API service.
